prompts: Generate a production original fantasy RPG pixel-painted sprite sheet based on attached silver-armored blue knight reference. Same identity: human male knight in polished silver plate, closed-open visor showing stern face, silver helmet with blue and white plume, royal blue tabard with silver cross emblem, blue split skirt and cape, brown belt, ONE straight silver single-handed longsword with small blue gem guard, no shield. Fine crisp game pixel-painting. TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA background, no checkerboard, no text, no title, no grid lines, no ground/shadow. EXACT 4 columns x3 rows of 12 distinct FULL BODY poses. Row2 4 distinct ATTACK phases: single-handed sword windup, horizontal swing, compact white slash crescent impact, recovery. Row3 2 CAST poses blue aura preparation and blue magical release, followed by 2 HIT poses stagger and recovery. Subtle compact blue aura wisps. All12 poses face the requested same direction, coherent weapon/plume and anatomy. Do NOT copy wrong-facing frames from user sheet. Direction DOWN: front three-quarter view facing viewer and slightly right.
